title: Chicken Tikka Masala German Style
description: A German twist on the classic Indian dish, with marinated chicken cooked in a rich cream sauce.

ingredients.name: chicken tikka masala spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at Indian or Middle Eastern markets

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together chicken tikka masala spice blend, salt, and 2 tablespoons of oil. Add the chicken and mix until coated.
2. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade, allowing any excess to drip off.
4. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
5. Add the sausage to the skillet and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
6. Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
7. Add the flour to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
8. Gradually add the chicken broth and heavy cream to the skillet, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
9. Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 2-3 minutes.
10. Stir in the butter until melted.
11. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
12. Serve the chicken and sauce over rice or with naan bread.
